scripts.compile:fib: pebble export --function-name fib --entry benchmarks/fibonacci_naive_recursion/fibonacci_naive_recursion.pebble && cp out/out.flat benchmarks/fibonacci_naive_recursion/fibonacci_naive_recursion.flat && aiken uplc decode benchmarks/fibonacci_naive_recursion/fibonacci_naive_recursion.flat > benchmarks/fibonacci_naive_recursion/fibonacci_naive_recursion.uplc
scripts.compile:fact: pebble export --function-name factorial --entry benchmarks/factorial_naive_recursion/factorial_naive_recursion.pebble && cp out/out.flat benchmarks/factorial_naive_recursion/factorial_naive_recursion.flat && aiken uplc decode benchmarks/factorial_naive_recursion/factorial_naive_recursion.flat > benchmarks/factorial_naive_recursion/factorial_naive_recursion.uplc
scripts.build: bun run compile:fib && bun run compile:fact
